title: Multidimensional quadratic BSDEs with weak interactions and their applications in mean-field games of controls
summary: The well-posedness of multidimensional quadratic backward stochastic differential equations (qBSDEs) remains one of the central open problems in BSDE theory. Motivated by a mean-field utility maximization model with price impact, we introduce a new class of multidimensional qBSDEs that lies beyond the scope of existing well-posedness results (see (2.15) for the generator). In order to study the limit as the number of players tends to infinity, we establish existence and uniqueness for a large class of such qBSDEs under suitable smallness conditions imposed on each individual dynamics.
